outputs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: complete 3×3 pixel-art dialogue portrait atlas, game NPC 077
Input image: Image 1 is approved complete version-5 atlas and exact portrait edit target.
Primary request: Create a fresh afraid emotion atlas. Same adult woman looks alert and alarmed, with WIDE OPEN sharp eyes, clear visible sclera around the irises, visible iris and pupil, and a straight-ahead gaze. Raise brows in clear alarm, but keep brow arches balanced and tense; do not lift inner brows into a sad, pleading, worried or sorrowful expression. Lips and face show restrained physical tension.
Style: Match the original coarse retro pixel-art pixels, muted game palette, skin, hair, lighting and purple background. Eyes must read as crisp deliberate pixel clusters at native 64×64 face size: sharp dark eyelid outline, clean iris/pupil, restrained sclera highlights, no fuzzy airbrushed shadow across the iris, no smoky blur.
Keep: same identity, haircut, head angle, head size, framing, face alignment, background, cell boundaries and square 3×3 atlas.
Mouths: Preserve nine useful distinct visemes in row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X: A closed M/B/P; B narrow consonant with slight teeth; C medium EH; D moderate AH; E rounded OH; F small OO/W; G upper teeth touch lower lip for F/V; H subtle tongue behind upper teeth for L; X relaxed closed. Keep mouth scale natural, no huge teeth or yawn.
Expression must differ immediately from a drooping, downcast sad face: wide alert eyes, forward attention, raised alarm brows, tense mouth corners. Keep same eye and brow expression across all nine cells.
Avoid: downcast gaze, drooping eyelids, inner-brow pleading arch, sad/sorrowful face, giant cartoon eyes, oversized sclera, changed head angle, added props, sweat, tears, labels, new borders or gutters, cropped facial parts, reordered or duplicated mouth poses. Full-frame complete sheet only.
